verdict.rationale: Brex documents first-party autonomous background automation. Users configure spend rules, approval flows and limits, and Brex AI agents then act on their own: the audit agent monitors expenses, the review agent auto-approves low-risk items and follows up on non-compliance, and AI assistants file reimbursements automatically. Approval routing, policy enforcement and receipt matching also run automatically. The evidence is marketing-level and covers only finance-domain workflows configured through policies, not a general automation builder; Zapier, Workato and webhook recipes are external building blocks and earn no credit. Missing for 10: a general-purpose user-defined automation or workflow builder (triggers, schedules, custom actions), in-depth first-party docs on configuring and monitoring the agents, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the agents run reliably unattended.
